name: "ECS Blue/Green ALB Switch"
description: "Flip ALB default and candidate rule between blue and green ECS services"

inputs:
  cluster:
    required: true
    description: "ECS cluster name or ARN"
  blue-service:
    required: true
    description: "ECS service name for BLUE"
  green-service:
    required: true
    description: "ECS service name for GREEN"
  listener-arn:
    required: true
    description: "ALB listener ARN for production traffic"
  candidate-rule-arn:
    required: true
    description: "ALB listener rule ARN for candidate path"
  tg-blue-arn:
    required: true
    description: "Target group ARN for BLUE"
  tg-green-arn:
    required: true
    description: "Target group ARN for GREEN"
  desired-count:
    required: true
    default: "1"
    description: "Desired task count for the new active service"
  drain-delay-minutes:
    required: true
    default: "15"
    description: "Delay (in minutes) before scaling down the old active service"
  event-rule-name:
    required: true
    description: "EventBridge rule name used to schedule scale-down"
  lambda-arn:
    required: true
    description: "Lambda ARN that scales an ECS service down to zero"

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Mask resource identifiers
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        echo "::add-mask::${{ inputs.listener-arn }}"
        echo "::add-mask::${{ inputs.candidate-rule-arn }}"
        echo "::add-mask::${{ inputs.tg-blue-arn }}"
        echo "::add-mask::${{ inputs.tg-green-arn }}"
        echo "::add-mask::${{ inputs.lambda-arn }}"

    - name: Detect blue/green state
      id: detect
      uses: ./.github/actions/ecs-detect-blue-green
      with:
        listener-arn: ${{ inputs.listener-arn }}
        candidate-rule-arn: ${{ inputs.candidate-rule-arn }}
        tg-blue-arn: ${{ inputs.tg-blue-arn }}
        tg-green-arn: ${{ inputs.tg-green-arn }}
        blue-service: ${{ inputs.blue-service }}
        green-service: ${{ inputs.green-service }}

    - name: Report blue/green service capacity
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SERVICES_JSON=$(aws ecs describe-services \
          --cluster "${{ inputs.cluster }}" \
          --services "${{ inputs.blue-service }}" "${{ inputs.green-service }}")

        FAILURES=$(jq -r '.failures | length' <<<"$SERVICES_JSON")
        if [ "$FAILURES" != "0" ]; then
          echo "::error::Unable to describe one or more blue/green ECS services."
          jq -r '.failures[] | "::error::" + (.arn // .reason) + " " + (.reason // "")' <<<"$SERVICES_JSON"
          exit 1
        fi

        BLUE_DESIRED=$(jq -r --arg svc "${{ inputs.blue-service }}" '.services[] | select(.serviceName == $svc) | .desiredCount' <<<"$SERVICES_JSON")
        GREEN_DESIRED=$(jq -r --arg svc "${{ inputs.green-service }}" '.services[] | select(.serviceName == $svc) | .desiredCount' <<<"$SERVICES_JSON")

        if [ "${BLUE_DESIRED}" = "0" ] && [ "${GREEN_DESIRED}" = "0" ]; then
          echo "::warning::Both blue and green ECS services have desiredCount=0. Continuing; the deployment will start the next color with desiredCount=${{ inputs.desired-count }}."
        fi

    - name: Ensure next (inactive) service is running and healthy
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        TARGET_SERVICE="${{ steps.detect.outputs.inactive_service }}"
        TARGET_TG="${{ steps.detect.outputs.inactive_tg }}"
        DESIRED="${{ inputs.desired-count }}"
        HEALTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300
        HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=10

        echo "Scaling up next ${DESIRED}-task color: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.inactive_color }}"

        aws ecs update-service \
          --cluster "${{ inputs.cluster }}" \
          --service "$TARGET_SERVICE" \
          --desired-count "$DESIRED" >/dev/null

        echo "Waiting for target service to become stable..."
        aws ecs wait services-stable \
          --cluster "${{ inputs.cluster }}" \
          --services "$TARGET_SERVICE"

        start="$(date +%s)"
        while true; do
          HEALTHY_COUNT=$(aws elbv2 describe-target-health \
            --target-group-arn "$TARGET_TG" \
            --query "length(TargetHealthDescriptions[?TargetHealth.State==\`healthy\`])" \
            --output text)

          if [[ "$HEALTHY_COUNT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$HEALTHY_COUNT" -ge "$DESIRED" ]; then
            echo "Next color has $HEALTHY_COUNT healthy ALB target(s). Ready to switch ALB listener."
            break
          fi

          now="$(date +%s)"
          elapsed=$((now - start))
          if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$HEALTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" ]; then
            aws elbv2 describe-target-health \
              --target-group-arn "$TARGET_TG" \
              --query 'TargetHealthDescriptions[].{Id:Target.Id,Port:Target.Port,State:TargetHealth.State,Reason:TargetHealth.Reason}' \
              --output json >&2 || true
            echo "::error::Expected at least ${DESIRED} healthy ALB target(s) before rollback switch."
            exit 1
          fi

          sleep "$HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS"
        done

    - name: Swap default action and candidate rule
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        NEW_DEFAULT_TG="${{ steps.detect.outputs.inactive_tg }}"
        NEW_CANDIDATE_TG="${{ steps.detect.outputs.active_tg }}"

        echo "Switching ALB default action to inactive color: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.inactive_color }}"

        aws elbv2 modify-listener \
          --listener-arn "${{ inputs.listener-arn }}" \
          --default-actions "Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=$NEW_DEFAULT_TG" >/dev/null

        aws elbv2 modify-rule \
          --rule-arn "${{ inputs.candidate-rule-arn }}" \
          --actions "Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=$NEW_CANDIDATE_TG" >/dev/null

        echo "Listener default action and candidate rule have been swapped."

    - name: Schedule delayed scale-down for the old active service
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        OLD_ACTIVE_SERVICE="${{ steps.detect.outputs.active_service }}"
        DELAY_MINUTES="${{ inputs.drain-delay-minutes }}"
        RULE_NAME="${{ inputs.event-rule-name }}"
        LAMBDA_ARN="${{ inputs.lambda-arn }}"
        SCHEDULE_UNIT="minutes"

        if [ "$DELAY_MINUTES" = "1" ]; then
          SCHEDULE_UNIT="minute"
        fi

        echo "Scheduling delayed scale-down for old active color after ${DELAY_MINUTES} minutes."

        aws events put-rule \
          --name "$RULE_NAME" \
          --schedule-expression "rate(${DELAY_MINUTES} ${SCHEDULE_UNIT})" >/dev/null

        TARGETS=$(jq -n \
          --arg arn "$LAMBDA_ARN" \
          --arg svc "$OLD_ACTIVE_SERVICE" \
          '[{Id:"scale-down", Arn:$arn, Input:( "{\"serviceName\":\"" + $svc + "\"}" )}]')

        aws events put-targets \
          --rule "$RULE_NAME" \
          --targets "$TARGETS" >/dev/null

        echo "EventBridge rule and targets configured."
